model_choice.accepted_scope: Fixture-local read-only evaluation of committed YYZ trajectory samples into duration, downrange, remaining-mass, consumed-mass and speed metrics, AtGrid termination decisions, a sealed terminal observation and a compact RunOutcome-shaped result.
model_choice.sampling_policy: Metrics and predicates read only committed boundary samples. Relations are inclusive. Evaluation stops at the first terminal boundary and retains that boundary in the terminal observation.
model_choice.composition_policy: TerminationPlan uses any-of composition. Higher integer priority wins simultaneous triggers; equal priority uses ascending stable predicate_id. Abort maps to Terminated and Complete maps to Completed.
model_choice.observation_policy: The terminal boundary order is publish committed sample, evaluate metrics, evaluate termination, seal terminal observation, then freeze result. No later sample is evaluated after a terminal decision.
excluded: canonical mission thresholds and qualification limits
stateful window metrics, continuous event location and partial-time commit
product Observation, TerminationDecision or RunOutcome contracts
session lifecycle, evidence durability, adapters and R1-R8 runtime capability

model.subject: vehicle.fixture.yyz@1
validity_domain: base_dt_s is positive and committed samples are finite
sample ticks are contiguous from zero and time_s equals tick * base_dt_s
commit ids are nonempty and unique, quality is Valid and mass is positive nonincreasing
position and velocity use the declared inertial frame
predicate ids are unique, priorities are nonnegative and relations are >= or <=
predicate metrics are duration_s, downrange_m or remaining_mass_kg
every fixture case reaches one AtGrid terminal decision

equivalence_cases.operation: reverse the predicate declaration order for both cases
equivalence_cases.expected: decision traces, metric summaries, terminal observations and result summaries remain equal

invalid_input_cases.mutation: change the terminal sample tick to three
reuse the tick-zero commit id at tick one
increase committed mass at tick one
set one velocity component to NaN
raise every completion threshold beyond the supplied trajectory

mutation_cases.mutation: read each next mass candidate at the current boundary
replace inclusive threshold relations with strict comparisons
freeze the result before sealing the terminal observation
continue evaluating samples after the first terminal boundary
